thread:
Alex (eng): T-minus 48h to the cross-team cutover. Doing an async dry-run here — please post a quick standup style update (what I did / blockers / today). Focused on canary config, FF gating, and rollback criteria.

Priya (infra): What I did: validated the new traffic-slice mapping in staging, confirmed IPs for staging probe.
Blocker: still waiting on a small NAT rule from networking for a partner region (ticket NET-842).
Today: follow up with Neteng + re-run smoke on the slice after rule is in.

Dan (runtime): Done: PR #3421 merged that fixes KV cache spinup under warm start. Verified with unit + integration tests.
Blocker: none for runtime, but we need to confirm quantized model variant is registered in model-catalog for the fallback path.
Today: push catalog entry and a compat test.

Emily (sre): What I did: ran 10k qps load profile against canary slice; p90 latency looks good but saw a steady increase in GC spikes at 15m mark.
Blocker: need to validate GC tune parameters on the dedicated hosts — I left a note in infra runbook.
Today: schedule a 30-min tuning window tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll be oncall during the cutover.

Ryan (prod-ops): What I did: prepped rollback checklist and rollback flag toggle path in FF-service. Added canary monitor dashboards (traffic, error-rate, latencies).
Blocker: dashboard alert thresholds need signoff from product/security.
Today: finalize alert thresholds and wire in PagerDuty run for high-error alarms.

Jamie (product): Quick note — we have one mid-size customer in the target cohort that requested extra notice. If rollback happens we need to coordinate CS messaging.
Question: agreed rollback criteria = sustained error-rate >1% for 5m OR p95 latency >1200ms for 10m?

Alex (eng): That sounds reasonable. Can we make it explicit in the runbook? Added a short section under "cutover -> rollback criteria" in the runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/cutover-2026 (please use that link).
Also: canary size = 2% traffic slice (approx 3 hosts) with capacity headroom.

Priya (infra): Adding the NAT rule should be done in ~2 hours. Once that's in I'll re-run smoke and post results here.

Dan (runtime): Model-catalog entry is up: model:v2-quantized -> canary-compatible tag. Ran compat test, passes.
Snippet of the slice binding we used in staging:
```json
{
  "slice": "canary-2pct",
  "route_policy": "weight-based",
  "fallback": "v2-quantized"
}
```

Emily (sre): GC tuning: lowered young-gen threshold and increased concurrent GC workers on the dedicated hosts in staging. Re-run of 10k qps shows stable p90 now. Will replay in prod staging tonight. :thumbsup:

Ryan (prod-ops): Dashboard alerts updated and sent to product/security for signoff (email + slack). PagerDuty rule created but not enabled until cutover starts.

Jamie (product): Signoff on alert thresholds via email is incoming. CS template drafted and shared in Google Drive (link: https://go.redwood/cs-templates/cutover-msg).

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy window created for 2026-03-19 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary slice rollout automation queued.

Alex (eng): Final asks before we close this thread: 1) Priya confirm NAT ticket done + smoke results, 2) Emily confirm GC tune in prod staging, 3) Ryan enable PD rules at T0 and confirm runbook owner oncall. Post short yes/no updates and we can call this green.

Priya (infra): NET-842 done at 2160001510. Smoke: all checks passed (auth, routing, healthz).

Emily (sre): GC tune replayed in prod staging at 2160001700, p95/p99 within expected. I'll be oncall T0.

Ryan (prod-ops): PagerDuty rules will be enabled at T-minus 5m (I'll flip the switch). Runbook owner = Emily.

Jamie (product): CS notified, customer contact flagged.

Dan (runtime): All good from runtime side. :white_check_mark:

Alex (eng): Great — thanks everyone. If anything unexpected pops up, ping this thread and @Emily. Otherwise we proceed with the advertised window. :rocket:
